questions.question: Explain why we divide by 115 instead of 100 when extracting VAT from a VAT inclusive amount.
questions.expected_answer: The VAT inclusive amount is the exclusive amount (100%) plus the VAT (15%). Therefore, the total amount given represents 115% of the original price, not 100%.

questions.question: When a customer buys goods for cash, why do we credit the VAT Control account instead of crediting all the money to Sales?
questions.expected_answer: The money collected for VAT does not belong to the business; it belongs to SARS. We credit VAT Control because it is a liability (money we owe to SARS), while Sales is only credited with the exclusive amount we actually earn.
